shortdesc.ph: Gets the storage path for media files to be cached.
Gets the storage path of cached media files.
Gets the storage path of the cached media files.

p.codeblock: virtual int getCacheDir(char* path, int length) = 0;

section.p: If you do not call to set the storage path for media files to be cached before calling this method, it returns the default storage path used by the SDK.
If has not been called before this method, it returns the default storage path used by the SDK.
If you have not called the method to set the storage path for the media files to be cached before calling this method, you get the default storage path used by the SDK.

plentry.pd: An output parameter. The storage path for media files to be cached.
The maximum length of the path string for the cache file storage path.
An output parameter; the storage path for the media file to be cached.

pd.ph: An input parameter; the maximum length of the cache file storage path string.
Fill in according to the cache file storage path string you obtained from path.

section.title: Return Values
section.p: If the method call succeeds, returns the storage path of cached media files. If the method call fails, returns an empty string.

ul.li: The call succeeds, and the SDK returns the storage path of the cached media files.
